chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'id al-Askari narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Hamdan al-Qushayri informed us, saying: Al-Mughira ibn Muhammad ibn al-Muhlib narrated to us, saying: Abdul Ghaffar Muhammad ibn Bakir al-Kalabi al-Kufi narrated to us, from Amr ibn Thabit, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

My love and the love of my Household is beneficial in seven occasions, whose terrors are great: at the time of death, and in the grave, and at the time of Resurrection, and at the time of receiving the Record, and at the time of Reckoning, and at the time of the Scales, and at the time of the Bridge.
ai.seo_question: What are the seven occasions in the afterlife where love for the Prophet and his Household is beneficial?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* underscores the centrality of *al-wala'* (affection) for the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt as a decisive intercessory force during the seven *ahwal* (states) of the afterlife. It reflects the Shia theological emphasis that this love serves as a protective shield against the terrors of death, the grave, and the final judgment, ensuring a favorable outcome in the weighing of deeds and crossing the Sirat.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 7-50 Al-Hassan ibn Abdullah ibn Sa’id al-Askari narrated that Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Hamdan al-Qushayri quoted Al-Muqayrih ibn Muhammad ibn al-Muhlib, on the authority of Abdul Qaf’far Muhammad ibn Bakir al-Kalabi al-Kufy, on the authority of Amr ibn Sabet, on the authority of Jabir, on the authority of Abi Ja’far al-Baqir (MGB), on the authority of Ali ibn al-Hussein as-Sajjad (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said,

“Love for me and my Household would be beneficial on seven occasions: time of death; in the grave; at the time of Resurrection; at the time of receiving one’s Record of Deeds; at the time of Reckoning; at the time of examining the good and bad deeds; and at the time of crossing the Bridge .”
